scientific_question: Can a local evidence-intent generator automatically produce answer-free scientific questions that approach the oracle-query retrieval ceiling without changing the existing retrieval/ranking stack?

research_basis.lesson: Predicting questions a document can answer can improve lexical retrieval and can approach more expensive reranking in latency-sensitive settings.
Generate multiple query perspectives and fuse their rankings rather than rely on one broad query.

research_basis.source: Complex Claim Verification with Evidence Retrieved in the Wild
research_basis.lesson: Separate decomposition, document retrieval, fine-grained evidence retrieval, summarization, and verification.

research_basis.source: Retrieval augmented scientific claim verification / SciFact-style pipeline
research_basis.lesson: Scientific evidence systems benefit from explicit evidence retrieval and sentence selection before verification.

generator_arms.description: Fixed generic scientific-evidence questions covering method, training, dataset, acquisition, baseline, metrics, quantitative results, conditions, robustness, limitations, and future work.

generator_arms.input_scope: topic + title + existing coarse top-12 selected source regions

deterministic_intents.question: What is the main method, framework, or algorithm proposed or evaluated?
How is the model or method trained, pre-trained, adapted, or otherwise prepared?
How are training examples, pairs, labels, or supervision signals constructed?
What datasets, testbeds, devices, samples, or domains are used?
What acquisition hardware, software, sensing setup, or measurement settings are used?
What baseline methods or comparison systems are used?
What evaluation metrics or success criteria are reported?
What quantitative results, gains, losses, or comparisons are reported?
Under what experimental conditions, scenarios, domains, or splits are results reported?
What robustness, generalization, domain-shift, or failure-case results are reported?
What limitations, weaknesses, or unresolved failure modes do the authors identify?
What future work or follow-up research do the authors propose?

teacher_anti_leak_audit.purpose: Teacher-only post-generation audit. Forbidden answer spans are never shown to the generator.
teacher_anti_leak_audit.numeric_token_policy: Any generated query containing a digit is rejected before retrieval.
teacher_anti_leak_audit.source_copy_policy: Reject a generated query if it copies a contiguous >=9-token sequence from its generator source context.

retrieval.candidate_pool: Same exact propositions on pages reached by the existing top-12 FACET_INTERLEAVED_BM25_V1 coarse region route.

evaluation.oracle_ceiling_reference: Use the frozen answer-free 13 oracle intents only as a non-trainable evaluation ceiling on the teacher paper; never feed oracle intents or teacher atoms to the generator.

WAVE7A_PROMISING: At least one Qwen-generated arm has teacher_leak_reject_fraction <= 0.20.
With BM25 or BGE hybrid, the arm supports >=10/13 teacher atoms inside the fused top-24 proposition budget.
The same arm recovers all three known misses e2.a/e2.b/e4.b.
Nine-paper historical evidence-page recall in merged top-24 is >=90% of the coarse selected-page recall ceiling.
WAVE7A_PARTIAL: No arm meets PROMISING, but at least one Qwen-generated arm supports >=8/13 teacher atoms at fused top-24 OR recovers all three known misses.
No hard provenance or anti-leak boundary fails.
WAVE7A_REJECT: No Qwen-generated arm meets PROMISING or PARTIAL, or a hard provenance/anti-leak boundary fails.
